observations.body: Before Pilate, Jesus distinguishes his Kingdom’s source from worldly rule and points to servants who do not fight to prevent his arrest.
observations.label: A Kingdom not from here

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside a kingdom not from here.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read John 18:34–38 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states before Pilate, Jesus distinguishes his Kingdom’s source from worldly rule and points to servants who do not fight to prevent his arrest. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A Kingdom not from here
